{{Quote|Although the YT-1300 is equipped with numerous automated systems to help a small crew operate the entire ship, Corellian Engineering Corporation does not expect any pilots to rely too much on mechanized support when they get behind the flight controls. Why? Because even though CEC offers conversion kits that can transform almost any ship into a drone barge, the YT-1300 doesn't fly like any other transport in its class. Some say it's not like any other ship at all.|''CEC YT-1300 Marketing Catalog''|<ref name="Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual">''[[Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual]]''</ref>}}
The '''''CEC YT-1300 Marketing Catalog''''' was a catalog that was produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] to promote sales of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. The catalog included quotes from the journalists [[Bali Rayden/Legends|Bali Rayden]] and [[Measel Junco/Legends|Measel Junco]], who were both impressed by the YT-1300's performance.
